subject: Agent deprecation notice — telemetry agent EOL and export runbook request
messages:
From: DataRelay Procurement <procurement@datarelay.io>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver@datarelay.io>
Date: Wed, 1 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Important: Telemetry agent EOL and migration window

Hi Sofia,

Quick note from DataRelay — we are deprecating our legacy telemetry agent (agent-telemetry v1.x) on 2028-06-15. The agent will stop accepting new telemetry ship calls after that date; we plan to fully decommission the service by 2028-07-01.

We know Redwood uses a lightweight relay that talks to our agent in a small set of EU regions. To make this transition smooth for our customers, we are consolidating the telemetry ingestion to a new managed proxy (agent-relay v2) hosted in Ireland and the Netherlands.

Action items for customers we are notifying:
- Confirm which subprocessor processes telemetry (we need a contact and the DPA annex).
- Confirm data egress routes and any cross-border transfer needs (we will provide a diagram).
- Confirm whether any on-prem routing or escrow is required during cutover.

Attachments: subprocessor_manifest_v2.xlsx (high level roster), egress_diagram.svg (draft)

Would you be able to confirm Redwood's required evidence package and a short canary/cutover window this week? We can provide a temporary dual-write for 30 days if needed.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Customer Success — DataRelay
procurement@datarelay.io

---

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: DataRelay Procurement <procurement@datarelay.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Important: Telemetry agent EOL and migration window

Oliver —

Thanks for the heads-up. A few asks from our side so we can route this through procurement, security, and legal efficiently:

1) Full subprocessor inventory: the attached manifest is a good start. Can you confirm for each entry whether data is at-rest encrypted with customer-segmented keys and which processors have KMS access? We need explicit answers per row.

2) Data flow + egress: the diagram helps; please annotate which POPs will terminate TLS and which will perform any transformation (redaction, aggregation). We must understand if any telemetry payloads transit non-EU jurisdictions.

3) DPA addendum draft: please share a DPA addendum that includes the onshore fallback and temporary dual-write clause (we prefer a 30-day window with retention and rollback SLAs).

4) Evidence: SOC2 Type II or ISO27001 certs for any processor that touches raw telemetry; and a snapshot of logs showing which tenant -> POP route you expect for Redwood.

We will also need to know whether the new agent-relay v2 introduces any new subprocessors (CDN, proxy, analytics) or swaps existing ones. If there are new subprocessors, we may request an escrow/temporary-access plan while we complete vendor clearance.

Proposed next steps:
- Please upload a revised manifest with KMS and certs column filled (subprocessor_manifest_v2.xlsx).
- Annotate egress_diagram.svg with POP-by-POP notes.
- Draft a DPA addendum and share (DocuSign-ready).

cc'ing Marissa (legal) and Kimberly (security) to coordinate evidence intake and a short procurement review. Jordan — can you carve a 2-hour slot tomorrow for a short runbook review?

Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@datarelay.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@datarelay.io
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Important: Telemetry agent EOL and migration window

Sofia —

Thanks — appreciate the clear checklist. I've attached the updated manifest and a draft DPA addendum (subprocessor_manifest_v2.xlsx, dpa_addendum_draft.docx) and updated the egress diagram (egress_diagram.svg) with POP notes. Quick answers inline below: 

- KMS access: Only two processors have KMS access (RelayStore Ltd and EdgeCache GmbH). We marked those in the manifest and included the CMKs' key regions.
- TLS termination: POPs in Dublin and Amsterdam terminate TLS; US POPs (for telemetry fanout) keep TLS to the managed proxy — no payload transformation outside EU POPs unless explicit aggregation is requested.
- New subprocessors: agent-relay v2 introduces EdgeCache GmbH (caching/egress), but no analytics vendor. EdgeCache is EU-based, ISO27001-certified; we have their cert linked in the manifest.
- Evidence: SOC2 Type II reports for RelayStore and EdgeCache are attached as links inside the manifest; full reports will be shared under NDA if needed.

We can support a 30-day dual-write starting 2028-06-01; canary window suggestion: 2028-06-01 to 2028-06-10 for traffic ramp.

If that works, I'll open a Docusign envelope for the DPA addendum and share a Drive folder with the SOC2 artefacts.

Regards,
Oliver
DataRelay

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@datarelay.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Important: Telemetry agent EOL and migration window

Oliver —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the updated artifacts. Next items from Redwood: 

- Marissa will review the DPA addendum and confirm any procurement terms by EOD 2028-05-03.
- Kimberly will validate the SOC2 links and ping for an NDA if we require full reports.
- Jordan and I will review the canary runbook; Jordan, please propose a 90-minute working session tomorrow at 10:00 or 14:00 UTC — want to lock on rollback triggers and retention carveouts.

Two small clarifications before we proceed with DocuSign: 
1) Please confirm that EdgeCache GmbH will not have access to unredacted PII (customer identifiers) other than ephemeral routing headers. We saw the manifest notes but want this explicit in the addendum.
2) For the KMS ownership you mentioned: confirm whether RelayStore's CMK is customer-segmented or a shared key per DataRelay customer cluster. We need customer-segmented keys for any onshore/fallback guarantee.

If both are affirmative, we're comfortable moving to DocuSign and scheduling the canary. Thanks again for the dual-write offer.

Sofia
Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
